edits.label: MainZone-Other
edits.why: Line 6 is the first line of the centred two-line title of no. 111 (Chukchi title running on to the Russian 'Воронъ и Орелъ въ'), centred under the heading '111.'; a heading is MainZone-Other, not a Continued paragraph body.
Line 7 ('перемѣнномъ бракѣ.') is the second line of the same title as line 6, so the two lines are one MainZone-Other band.

notes.text: Colophon 'Записано отъ чукчи ... въ 1896 г.' sits roughly centred/inset, labelled MainZone-P by the rule; it is a source note ending the previous text, not a paragraph. Left as is since no ruling decides it.
